resources.string: Keep the video frame fixed while the phone rotates. Choose an app or window directly in Galaxy’s recording start dialog. Settings apply to the next recording. Experimental: Android 16 / One UI 8.5, SM-S948Q. Enable this module for System Framework, SystemUI, and Samsung Capture, then soft-reboot the phone.
Master switch. When off, every extension below is disabled. Individual choices are kept for the next time you enable it.
Keep the initial video dimensions and rotate captured footage with the phone. Does not change the orientation of the phone itself.
Add app and window targets directly to the Galaxy recording start dialog.
Add Window to the recording-area choices. Capture one selected window rather than following other screens in the same app.
Allow hooks to be tried again. Soft-reboot the phone after resetting.
MIT project. Material Components and AndroidX: Apache License 2.0. Xposed API is used only at compile time.
Individual features · active only when the master switch is on
For Android app recordings, capture the selected app audio. Galaxy recordings can choose target app audio or all app audio in the start dialog. Microphone selection is separate.

Keep footage in the same direction when switching between opposite portrait or landscape orientations. Works with either recording start orientation, including landscape starts with black-bar correction off.
